story: A stranger paid for my groceries when my card declined, then walked away before I could thank him.
A taxi driver drove me 20 minutes out of his way to a hospital and refused to take any money.
During a downpour, a shopkeeper handed out free umbrellas to everyone waiting at the bus stop.
A teenager gave up his seat and then quietly carried an elderly woman's bags up three flights of stairs.
Neighbours secretly repainted a widow's fence overnight as a birthday surprise.
A barista wrote encouraging notes on every cup during exam week. Mine said: you are almost there.
A bus full of commuters helped push a stalled car off a busy intersection in the rain.
A stranger found my lost wallet and mailed it back with all the cash still inside and a kind letter.
The whole street cooked meals for a family after their home flooded. Nobody asked for credit.
A man spent his lunch break teaching a nervous new driver how to parallel park.
A cafe owner quietly lets students study for hours and refills their tea for free.
A cyclist stopped to fix a stranger's flat tyre and left before she could offer money.
Fishermen turned back from their catch to tow a broken-down boat safely to shore.
A librarian saved a rare book for a kid who visited every week but could never afford it, then gifted it.
Someone shovelled the snow off my entire block's driveways before sunrise. Still no idea who.
A construction crew built a wheelchair ramp for a neighbour on their weekend off.
A young woman sat with a lost tourist for an hour until his family found him.
Market sellers each donated one item so a struggling mother could fill her basket.
A stranger noticed I was crying on the train and handed me a chocolate bar and a tissue.
Villagers carried an injured hiker four kilometres down the mountain on a makeshift stretcher.
A bakery leaves its unsold bread in a basket outside every night, free for anyone who needs it.
My landlord waived a month's rent when I lost my job, and never once mentioned it again.
A group of teenagers cleaned an entire beach after a festival without being asked.
A nurse stayed three hours past her shift so a patient wouldn't be alone overnight.
A truck driver stopped traffic on the highway to walk a family of ducks across.
Someone paid off the entire layaway list at a small toy shop before the holidays.
A stranger gave me his jacket at a freezing bus stop and got on the next bus in a t-shirt.
Office workers pooled money to send the cleaning staff's daughter to university.
An old man waters every unclaimed plant on our apartment block, quietly, every morning.
A surf instructor gave free lessons all summer to kids who couldn't pay a cent.
